summary: Frontend-only regression of the Come In Expo web preview after targeted fixes. 27 scripted checks covering home, location modal + reload persistence, add-to-cart + reload persistence, cart inc/dec/clear/empty-state, search, categories list, category chip row + jump-between, product details (p1 Aashirvaad Atta), services booking confirmation, request-anything disabled-until-filled + success modal, account groups, and +not-found route. 27/27 passed on re-verification. Catalog image uniqueness audit confirmed: p15 (Surf Excel photo-1583947215259) and p16 (Vim photo-1584820927498) are now distinct; p19 (Fortune Oil photo-1620706857370) and p20 (MDH photo-1596040033229) are distinct.
critical_code_review_comments: src/store/cart.tsx (L48-60): dual-shape read (string | object) for cart is a sensible migration path, but the legacy raw-object fallback should be removed in a follow-up once a release cycle has passed to simplify the read path.

src/store/location.tsx still imports AsyncStorage directly for the one-time legacy read; acceptable as a migration, but worth isolating behind the storage util to keep the single-source-of-truth contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All testIDs listed in the review request are present and functional. Note: on first-time flows the category screen can take ~2-3s to hydrate the FlatList, so prefer waiting on `[data-testid="product-card-<id>"]` with a 5s timeout rather than relying on an immediate is_visible check. Location persistence verified via storage util; cart persistence verified via JSON-string wrapping. +not-found route works and navigates home via not-found-home-btn.
rca_of_issue: N/A - verification pass; previously-reported audit fixes are confirmed working.
